signOut.title: Sign Out
signOut.desc: This device stops being signed in. The wallet itself is not deleted — your passkey stays in Face ID / fingerprint.
signOut.keeps: Choose “I already have a wallet” to sign back in with that passkey: the same address returns, and your history, contacts, tokens and settings are still here.
signOut.warning: Your public key has not reached the sync server yet. It will be retried on the next launch, but until it succeeds you may not be able to sign in on another device — or here, if you remove the app.
signOut.descMany: All {{count}} wallets on this device sign out. Nothing is deleted.

eraseDevice.title: Erase This Device
eraseDevice.subtitle: Delete everything Vela stored here
eraseDevice.desc: Everything Vela stored on this device is deleted. No backup, no undo.
eraseDevice.loses: You lose: transaction history, contacts and groups, browsing history, dApp permissions, custom tokens and networks, endpoint settings and every preference.
eraseDevice.keeps: You keep the wallet: its passkeys are with your passkey provider, not this app — sign in again and the same address returns. Not erased: Vela Relay keeps sent transactions up to 14 days, the key index keeps registrations up to 30 days, and the public-key record on chain is permanent; no one can delete it.
eraseDevice.failed: The erase did not finish. Some data is still on this device and you are still signed in — try again.
eraseDevice.failedHeld: Everything Vela stored here was deleted, but another tab still has Vela's storage open, so the erase could not finish. Close Vela in your other tabs and windows, then try again.
eraseDevice.unsynced: Not finished syncing: {{names}}. Until a wallet syncs, no other device can find it — erasing now may lose it for good.
eraseDevice.unsyncedAck: I understand an unsynced wallet may be lost for good

networks.saveHint: Saved as soon as you leave the field. It is refused only when the RPC reports a different chain ID.
